speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia (X-linked bleeding disorder) with concurrent low levels of both Factor VIII and Factor IX. Given the family history of joint swelling in your uncle and your current gum bleeding post-extraction, the presence of low Factor VIII and IX confirms a coagulation factor deficiency. This is not an emergency requiring immediate transport, but you do need urgent hematology consultation for factor replacement therapy and dental care planning.
